name: Lomac Gearstrip
summary: In Ironforge's Tinker Town, Lomac Gearstrip pursues gnomish inventions. He formulated the NG-5 explosive and stays in contact with fellow researchers in Kalimdor.

sections.title: A Spark in Tinker Town
sections.body: Lomac Gearstrip works on gnomish ordnance in Ironforge's Tinker Town. Like many gnomes who fled Gnomeregan's tragedy, he brought his tinkering operations to the dwarven capital. His workshop centers on volatile chemical mixtures and specialized munitions meant to overcome heavily defended enemy strongholds.

sections.title: The NG-5 Explosive
sections.body: Lomac's proudest contribution to combat engineering is the NG-5 explosive. The compound is made for great destructive force and demands precise handling and rare chemical reagents. To refine and use such hazardous inventions in the field, Lomac stays in touch with former colleagues in distant theaters. They exchange technical orders and dangerous supplies across the Great Sea.

faq.q: Where can I find Lomac Gearstrip?
faq.answer: Lomac works in Tinker Town, the gnomish quarter in eastern Ironforge.

faq.q: What is Lomac Gearstrip famous for inventing?
faq.answer: Lomac is best known for formulating the NG-5 explosive, made to bring great firepower to gnomish endeavors.

faq.q: Why does Lomac deal with contacts in Kalimdor?
faq.answer: Lomac keeps in touch with former research peers and colleagues in frontier regions such as Stonetalon Mountains. They coordinate hazardous chemical ingredients and test his explosives in active operations.

faq.q: What kind of tasks does Lomac offer to adventurers?
faq.answer: Lomac entrusts Alliance couriers with carrying purchase orders and volatile chemical reagents between Ironforge and researchers abroad. These deliveries often involve his NG-5 explosive experiments.

faq.q: What is the Purchase Order Receipt tied to Lomac?
faq.answer: Lomac authored the Purchase Order Receipt, a manifest for organizing and documenting shipments of specialized equipment and dangerous volatile reagents between tinkerers.

faq.q: Is Lomac affiliated with Gnomeregan's refugees?
faq.answer: Yes. Lomac belongs to the displaced Gnomeregan community living under the hospitality of Ironforge's dwarves while continuing his engineering work.

angles.text: Lomac's NG-5 explosive reflects advanced gnomish pyrotechnics and may inspire tinkerers interested in powerful blasting compounds.
As a gnome, Lomac shares Tinker Town's resilient drive, pursuing demanding technical research while exiled from Gnomeregan.
Alliance operatives traveling between Ironforge and expedition outposts in Kalimdor often handle sensitive munitions and volatile formulas for Lomac.
